programs.name: Meteorology
programs.description: Includes recurrent and capital expenditures related to hydrological and meteorological research and monitoring; dissemination of weather forecasts, early warnings, and information on potential hazards and natural disasters to the public; prevention of weather-related risks and severe environmental pollution; activities influencing weather and climate conditions; and the effective utilization of weather and climate resources.

programs.name: Security of protected areas
programs.description: Includes recurrent and capital expenditures related to the implementation of policies and protection regimes for protected areas, implementation and monitoring of protected area management plans, promotion and awareness-raising activities related to protected areas, and the establishment and maintenance of protected area information databases.

programs.name: Water resource, lake and river management
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to the core functions of state institutions responsible for water resources, including the Water Authority, Freshwater Resources and Nature Conservation Center, and River Basin Administrations, covering water resource management, improvement and enforcement of water-related legislation, coordination, regulation, and provision of professional and methodological guidance.

programs.name: Afforestation
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to the core functions of state institutions responsible for forestry, including the Forestry Agency and inter-Soum forest units, covering the establishment of sustainable forest management systems, improvement and implementation of forest legislation, coordination, regulation, and provision of professional and methodological guidance.

programs.name: Environment policy and administration
programs.description: Includes recurrent and capital expenditures related to the core functions of government institutions responsible for environmental governance, including improvement of the legal and regulatory framework, development and implementation of legislation and development policies, budget management and oversight, and ensuring integrated coordination and administration.

programs.name: Air pollution abatement, climate change
programs.description: Includes financing for activities related to the implementation of the National Program on Air and Environmental Pollution Reduction and climate change policies and plans, aimed at ensuring a healthy and safe living environment for citizens.

programs.name: R&D Environment
programs.description: Includes recurrent and capital expenditures related to research activities aimed at preventing environmental pollution and degradation, reducing pollution, and mitigating environmental impacts.

programs.name: Environmental pollution and degradation
programs.description: Includes recurrent and capital expenditures related to reducing air pollution and conducting quality control; developing alternative products to replace pollution sources; cleaning, collection, transport, disposal, and recycling of waste from public roads, spaces, and facilities; establishment and maintenance of waste recycling services and facilities; and other support measures aimed at reducing environmental pollution.

programs.name: Waste management
programs.description: Includes financing for activities related to the implementation of the Law on Waste and national and local waste management programs, aimed at reducing the negative impacts of waste on human health and the environment.

programs.name: Biodiversity conservation
programs.description: Includes financing for activities related to the implementation of the National Biodiversity Program and related policy documents, aimed at conserving biodiversity at ecosystem, species, and genetic levels, promoting sustainable use, and ensuring fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising from the use of biological resources.

programs.name: Protection of endangered animals, plants and species
programs.description: Includes financing for activities related to the implementation of the National Program for the Protection of Endangered and Rare Species, the Program for the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Rare Plants of Mongolia, and objectives of the National Biodiversity Program, covering protection, restoration, and sustainable use of endangered and rare animal and plant species.

programs.name: Environment protection, recovery
programs.description: Includes recurrent and capital expenditures related to environmental protection and restoration activities, including: prevention of water pollution, sustainable use of water resources, improvement of water supply levels, protection against water scarcity, expansion of water sources, construction of reservoirs; forest protection and restoration activities such as afforestation, reforestation, seedling preparation and propagation, pest control, forest fire prevention and damage compensation, and forest cleaning; protection of plants from diseases, harmful rodents, pests, and chemical or biological impacts, establishment of quarantine measures, studies on plant distribution and resources, ecological and economic valuation, restoration and cultivation of rare plants; wildlife protection, breeding, sustainable use, reintroduction of endangered species, captive breeding, creation of sustainable use reserves, research, training and awareness-raising, biotechnology measures, monitoring of hunting activities, and prevention of illegal hunting; research, documentation, protection, and regulation of traditional knowledge associated with plant and animal genetic resources, promotion of bioprospecting, innovation research and product development related to genetic resources and associated traditional knowledge, and public awareness and legal outreach related to genetic resources.

programs.name: Reduce land degradation and prevent from desertification
programs.description: Includes financing for projects and measures related to the implementation of the National Action Program to Combat Desertification and related policy documents, aimed at protecting soil and land resources from degradation, reducing the spread of desertification, and restoring degraded land.

programs.name: Air pollution reduction
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to reducing and preventing air pollution.

programs.name: Solid waste and environmental pollution removal and cleaning services
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to environmental cleaning services, cleaning of public roads and areas, and waste removal.

programs.name: Afforestation
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to establishing plantation forests and forest funds, forest restoration and propagation, and conducting forest inventories in accordance with the Law on Afforestation. Exclusions: expenditures related to tree planting in urban streets, parks, and green spaces are not recorded under this category and are instead recorded under code 82207.

programs.name: Control of forest pests and harmful insects
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to controlling forest pests and harmful insects.

programs.name: Forest fire prevention and damage mitigation
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to forest fire prevention, fire suppression, and mitigation of damage caused by forest fires.

programs.name: Forest inventory
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to conducting forest inventories in accordance with forest legislation.

programs.name: Plant protection and restoration
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to the protection and restoration of natural vegetation.

programs.name: Hydrological and meteorological research
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to hydrological and meteorological research and analysis activities.

programs.name: Waste processing
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to waste separation and processing.

programs.name: Support for substitute pollution sources and green product producers
programs.description: Includes budgetary support and incentives provided to producers of products aimed at reducing air and environmental pollution.

programs.name: Protection, use, and restoration of water and mineral water resources
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to protection and restoration of water and mineral water resources, construction of reservoirs, sustainable use of water resources, and wastewater recycling and treatment.

programs.name: Reduction of land degradation and desertification prevention
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to restoration of degraded land, mitigation of desertification, protection against sand movement, fencing and protection of pastureland, and restoration of vegetation cover.

programs.name: Protection and restoration of wildlife resources
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to wildlife protection, captive breeding and reintroduction of endangered and rare species, and implementation of biotechnological measures.

programs.name: Genetic resources of wild plants and animals
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to research, assessment, registration, and conservation of genetic resources of wild plants and animals.

programs.name: Forest restoration
programs.description: Includes expenditures related to forest restoration activities aimed at increasing forest resources, including preparation and propagation of seedlings and plantation forest establishment, in accordance with the Law on Afforestation.

notes: The report's Tables 9 and 10 print 8 figures that differ from its workbook by more than rounding (at most MNT 0.09 billion); the record follows the workbook, whose totals the report's total row matches.

The review's workbook holds different parts of the budget each year: 2020 and 2021 the State and the local budgets, 2022 and 2024 the local budgets only, 2023 the State budget only. A year total is given for 2020 and 2021 only.

Counted is the review's own rule: every line item of the 13 environment programmes at the attribution rate (BAR) of its purpose code, plus 15 environmental purpose codes in other programmes at 100%. Core operating costs count at 100%; capital works coded 80918 at 5%.
All public spending is the State budget and the local budgets, each as executed (gross); transfers from the State budget to local budgets are not netted out.

2024: the workbook's BAR sheet and the report's Table 11 give MNT 196.41 billion, MNT 19.73 billion less than its Program sheet and Table 9, because a helper column those totals filter on is blank in the 2024 sheet's first 130,690 rows. The record follows the Program sheet.
Line names and descriptions are the report's own (Tables 1 and 2); spending units are named as in the workbook, in English where its 2016-2021 sheet gives English.
